# LSTM stage 3: equal tuning budget (generated by `scripts/run_lstm_stage3.py`)

Validation period only. L4_full_A tuned with up to 90 trials per horizon in total (12 from the first tuning + 78 new, widened search space, pruning after epoch 3), then 3 seeds with the selected configuration, as in the first LSTM run. Selection by validation MAE only; early stopping on validation, so the numbers are mildly optimistic.

## Horizon 1 h

- Trials: 12 old + 78 new (55 pruned); tuning time of the new trials 116 min.
- Best trial MAE: first 12 trials 1,677 MW; all 35 eligible trials 1,626 MW (selected new#34: hidden 96, lr 0.007228, dropout 0.15, weight decay 6.4e-05).
- Final validation MAE (3 seeds): per-seed mean 1,604 MW (range 1,563-1,626); mean prediction 1,530 MW; best epochs [9, 8, 6].
- First LSTM L4 run (12 trials): per-seed mean 1,659 MW. XGBoost headline S4 (stage 2) per-seed mean 1,112 MW.
